NOTE
**Still not ready — checklist item still unchecked, and no comparison to the other open PRs for this issue**

New: The author squashed to one commit on current `main`, fixed multi-line text handling, and CI is passing. Missing: the "Automated tests verify logic" checklist box is still unchecked, and the description doesn't say how this PR relates to the open PRs for #19589 (#38098, #39481, #39606).

###### Next step

"not ready" stays; laurynmm, who gave the earlier feedback, can post the reply below.

###### Reply

```quote

Two things are still missing: the "Automated tests verify logic" checkbox in the self-review checklist is unchecked, and the description should explain how this PR compares to the other open PRs for #19589 (#38098, #39481, #39606); see [continuing unfinished work](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/continuing-unfinished-work.html). Please update the description and post again.
```
